name: ProductBoxes – Mix and Match Box Builder for WooCommerce
author: BestWebExpert

sections.description:
ProductBoxes is a free mix and match box builder for WooCommerce that lets customers build their own product box. Shoppers choose items from your store, fill a box, see available savings and add their selection to the cart. You control which products can be picked, how many fit and what the completed box costs.

Create build-your-own gift boxes, clothing bundles, snack boxes, beauty kits, coffee samplers or “pick any 3” deals.

Set up campaigns in a guided editor with live preview. Publish with a WordPress block or shortcode. Prices are calculated and validated on the server.

100% free: No paid version, locked features or account required.

ProductBoxes demo and website

  • BestWebExpert – Plugin developer and owner – Visit the official website of the team behind ProductBoxes.
  • ProductBoxes website and plugin details – Learn more about the WooCommerce mix and match box builder.
  • Live capsule wardrobe box demo – Explore a build-your-own-box storefront with tiered discounts.

Three ways to sell product boxes

  • Tiered mix and match discounts: Reward larger boxes, such as 10% off 2 items, 15% off 3 and 20% off 5. Show progress toward the next discount while shoppers build.
  • Fixed-size gift boxes: Offer selectable box sizes, such as 3 or 5 products, with a discount or box price for each size.
  • Fixed-price product bundles: Set a single price for an exact number of items, such as any 3 shirts for $120.

Shopper-friendly storefront

  • Visual product grid, category filters and sorting.
  • Live box slots, totals and progress toward the next discount.
  • Sidebar summary or sticky bar; mobile-friendly bottom sheet on phones.
  • Eligible simple products and individual variations.
  • Optional gift wrap and gift message.
  • Edit boxes from the cart; supports classic and block cart/checkout.

Flexible box campaign rules

  • Select products individually, by category or by tag.
  • Set minimum/maximum items and per-product limits.
  • Offer percentage discounts, box sizes or bundle prices.
  • Disable or hide sold-out items.
  • Schedule campaigns, with a countdown if an end date is set.
  • Customize layout, text, labels, colors and discount ladder.
  • Display the cart as one bundle line or a box plus each item.

WooCommerce management and analytics

  • Manage campaigns, statuses and placements with live preview.
  • Track views, product picks, funnel steps, conversion, revenue, discounts and top products.
  • Save box items, discounts and gift messages in orders and emails.
  • Reduce stock for each purchased item inside a box.
  • Supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and block checkout.
  • Keep optional analytics in your own database.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or later
  • WooCommerce 9.0 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later

External services

ProductBoxes does not contact external services. It uses no CDN, remote fonts, telemetry, licence checks or remote update checks. Assets are bundled locally.

Privacy

Optional builder analytics are stored in this site’s database. They track builder views, product picks, discount-tier milestones, cart additions and box purchases.

  • A random session ID is stored in browser sessionStorage. No tracking cookie is set.
  • Only a daily salted hash of that ID is saved. IP addresses and user agents are not stored; the daily salt prevents matching sessions across days.
  • Disabling analytics or using the mmbb_track_events filter stops new collection, including purchase events. Refund and cancellation corrections continue to apply.
  • Raw events are deleted after the retention period (90 days by default). Daily totals and order-line sales records remain for reporting and late refunds.

Gift messages are stored with WooCommerce order items. WordPress personal data tools can export them and erase them when WooCommerce order-data removal settings permit it.

Source code and build

JavaScript and CSS source is in src/. Build files: package.json and webpack.config.js. React and @wordpress dependencies come from WordPress.

To build with Node.js 20.19 or later:

npm install
npm run build

Build output: build/. Composer is only needed for development tools, not runtime.

Public repository: https://github.com/Razibul-Hasan/productboxes-mix-and-match-box-builder

Developer hooks

  • mmbb_campaign_config_defaults (filter): new campaign defaults, sanitized again.
  • mmbb_templates (filter): campaign picker templates.
  • mmbb_pricing_quote (filter): quote, config, items and options; integer minor units.
  • mmbb_campaign_saved (action): campaign ID and sanitized config after save.
  • mmbb_ensure_container_product (filter): hidden product ID, WP_Error or null.
  • mmbb_track_events (filter): return false to disable tracking.

Credits

ProductBoxes is developed and maintained by BestWebExpert.

The bundled Figtree and Bricolage Grotesque fonts use the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Licence files: assets/fonts/Figtree-OFL.txt and assets/fonts/BricolageGrotesque-OFL.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.0 or later.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New, search for “ProductBoxes” and install it. Or upload productboxes-mix-and-match-box-builder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate ProductBoxes. Multisite installs use per-site settings.
  4. Open ProductBoxes > Campaigns and choose Create campaign (or start from a template).
  5. Select products, box rules and design, then publish.
  6. Add the ProductBoxes Box Builder block or [mmbb_box id="12"] shortcode to a page (replace 12 with your campaign ID).
sections.faq:
What is a mix and match box builder?

Shoppers pick eligible products to fill a box. Offer tiered discounts, fixed box sizes or fixed-price bundles.

Is ProductBoxes free?

Yes. There are no paid upgrades, locked features or accounts.

Can I try the mix and match box builder before installing?

Yes. Explore the capsule wardrobe box demo to see product selection, box slots and tiered discount progress.

How do I add the box builder to a page?

Select a page when publishing, use the ProductBoxes Box Builder block or paste [mmbb_box id="12"]. Optional attributes: layout (panel, bar or both), columns (3, 4 or 5) and hero (true or false).

Can I sell any 3 products for a fixed price?

Yes. Choose Bundle price, set an item count and box price, then select eligible products.

Can shoppers choose product variations?

Yes. Simple products and individual variations are supported.

Does the builder work on mobile and with my theme?

Scoped styles work within themes following WordPress standards. Tested with Twenty Twenty-Five and Storefront. Mobile displays a two-column grid, sticky bar and bottom sheet.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. Box details and editing work with classic and block carts. Locked quantities in “Box plus each item” mode are fully supported in the classic cart.

How are taxes handled when products have different tax classes?

The default single cart line uses the hidden box product’s tax class (Standard unless changed). For individual tax rates, select “Box plus each item”.

Does the plugin load on every page?

By default, assets load only on builder pages. Change this in Settings.

What is the hidden Box container product?

Each published campaign creates a hidden cart container product. Edit the campaign, not this product. It is trashed with the campaign.

What happens if WooCommerce is inactive?

The plugin stays inactive and displays a dismissible notice.

What happens to data when I uninstall?

Data stays unless you enable “Delete all plugin data”. Orders are never deleted. The setting is off by default per multisite site.

Does ProductBoxes send analytics to external servers?

No. Optional analytics stay in your database and record neither IP addresses nor user agents. See Privacy.

Can developers customize ProductBoxes?

Yes. Source and build instructions are included, with mmbb_ hooks listed below.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: tiered discounts, fixed-size and fixed-price box campaigns, builder block and shortcode, classic and block cart and checkout support, order details, analytics and settings.
